lines.text: Hey. I'm 哆啦币梦.StandX - Content Squad. Quality content can earn 5 to 15 points per piece. Weekly highlight adds more.
Depth. Content that teaches, analyzes, and gives context. Hype will not make you stand out. An honest analysis of how DUSD works can.
And visuals matter. Visual consistency is a differentiator: identity, readability, clarity. Creative Squad lives on that.
I'm 冷酷锦鲤.StandX - Content/Research. I came from a CEX. I thought knowing trade was enough to make technical content. It was not.
The community can feel when something is shallow. Technical depth with a human voice - that is the path.
